description: This script sets up and executes a tool called 'tsgo' within a Node.js environment, managing lock acquisition and release around the subprocess invocation.

methods.name: applyLocalTsgoPolicy
methods.description: Adjusts process.argv and environment variables according to the local Tsgo policy.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Synchronously acquires a lock to ensure exclusive access during the 'tsgo' tool execution.
